long_biography.plain_text:
Swedish entrepreneur David Gustav Kellermann entered apparel trading through Scandinavian Manufactrust before visiting St Petersburg's Pervomayskaya Zarya factory after the Soviet period. Working with Galina Sintsova and Mikhail Urzhumtsev, he helped redirect the manufacturer toward branded retail. Their partnership produced Melon Fashion Group in 2005, combining established Zarina operations with Befree and later Love Republic and Sela.

Kellermann served as a major shareholder and board chair while the group expanded across Russia and neighbouring markets. He later converted part of his own holding into shares for about 1,400 long-serving employees. He also pursued security technology, co-inventing a smart screening barrier associated with Apstec Systems, where he served as chairman before leaving the board.
